description: Payer-specific denial risk weights. Higher = stricter payer = higher base risk score.

rationale.CIGNA: 90-day timely filing window (industry's strictest). Requires prior auth on most procedures. Highest denial rate in portfolio.
rationale.AETNA: 180-day timely filing. Strict subscriber ID format. HMO plans require referrals.
rationale.BCBS: 365-day timely filing but strict taxonomy and modifier requirements.
rationale.HUMANA: 365-day timely filing. Taxonomy required. Known for medical necessity denials.
rationale.MEDICARE: 365-day window but strict NUCC taxonomy and CLIA requirements. Lowest commercial denial rate.
